examples.title: Contextual panel
examples.description: Panel starts open by default. It is a non-modal complementary panel; the parent supplies its available height.

examples.title: Open, close and return focus
examples.description: The parent owns open. Close or Escape requests onClose; the opener remains available outside the panel.

examples.title: All sizes
examples.description: sm, default and lg prefer 280, 320 and 400px widths but stay within the available container.

examples.title: Native form and footer action
examples.description: The footer submit button targets the body form by id. Save changes updates a local status in the persistent footer.

examples.title: Scrollable history
examples.description: The body scrolls independently while the header and footer remain available.

examples.title: Custom header
examples.description: header replaces the default title and close button. Supply your own controls and an accessible panel label.
